title: cohens_kappa stdlib function
notes: Create src/modules/mechanism_classifier/kappa.py: cohens_kappa(labels_a:list, labels_b:list)->float using stdlib only (collections.Counter, no sklearn). Formula: kappa=(p_o - p_e)/(1 - p_e) where p_o=observed agreement, p_e=expected chance agreement from marginals. Degenerate: if 1-p_e==0 (all same class), return 0.0. Export from __init__. Tests: perfect_agreement (identical lists) -> 1.0; no_agreement on a 2-class balanced swap -> -1.0 or <=0; balanced_random (half/half both lists same composition) -> 0.0; degenerate_single_class -> 0.0 without crash. Use concrete fixtures (not approximations) where kappa is analytically known.
